HAND SCALE / Lots, texts, names & numbers

Geomancy.

A family of divinatory systems using generated figures, often formed from odd and even groups of marks.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Geomancy
Geomancia

A name for several traditions; here it primarily refers to divination through generated dot figures.

ʿIlm al-raml
Ciencia de la arena

An Arabic name for the geomantic tradition literally associated with sand.

Geomantic figure
Figura geomántica

A figure of single and double marks whose construction and meaning follow a stated geomantic system.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

The British Museum’s Islamic geomantic instrument documents figures known in the context of ʿilm al-raml. Other traditions use the word geomancy differently; the term alone does not identify a common procedure.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Name the tradition and define the rule for turning marks into figures.
  2. Retain the raw marks and the derived chart together.
  3. Explain the interpretive correspondences with their source.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Photograph the complete chart with every dot clear.
  • Include the raw mark sequence and the source or legend used to derive the figures.
